name: Promotion Bar
author: Nimesh Gorfad

sections.description:
The Promotion Bar plugin allows you to create and display customizable promotion bars on your WordPress site. Use it to highlight special offers, announcements, or any important information you want to draw attention to.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. For more information, see License URI.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the promotion-bar folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings via the ‘Promotion Bar’ menu in the WordPress admin.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the promotion bar?

Navigate to the ‘Promotion Bar’ settings page in the WordPress admin. From there, you can customize the text, colors, and display options.

Can I schedule promotions?

Yes, you can set start and end dates for your promotions in the settings.
